name: RoboOrchard Core v0.6.0-release
body:
# RoboOrchard Core v0.6.0-release

RoboOrchard Core 0.6.0 expands configuration safety and serialization, camera and transform datatype operations, CLI extensibility, runtime lifecycle handling, and contributor documentation while tightening compatibility boundaries for downstream users upgrading from v0.4.0-release.

## What's Changed

### New Features

#### Configuration & Serialization

- Extend batched dataclass handling and configuration I/O ergonomics, including nested camera and geometry data paths. (commit d4d8244c536b42592a6527428d840aa7ea2c09a7)
- Add typed `ConfigInstanceOf` validation, headerless typed-config loading, lossless YAML rendering for multiline strings, and JSON-sequence flattening. (commit 6aa3eaa0fa10741cde2a2f6bf862f9fe90d04f7c)

#### Camera, Transforms & Math

- Add integer, slice, and list indexing to `BatchFrameTransformGraph`, enforce singleton-or-effective-batch edge semantics, and provide explicit singleton transform materialization. (commit bb3e06131b82ecd068bcd0898a68bfd542ca8dea)
- Add `ensure_quaternion_sequence_continuous` for validated, hemisphere-consistent quaternion sequences. (commit 6cb42755e277c8669076a0f13b44b386dee56360)
- Add decoded camera resize and JPEG encoding support together with the public CLI-extension surface. (commit ed41db028b2211a4c17e9c782f2506a3efd860ab)
- Add decode-resize-reencode support for encoded camera batches, custom codec hooks, JPEG quality controls, and PNG compression controls. (commit a6e0ab724fdafc05246f2bebe012dc7e4f4bc569)

#### CLI & Tools

- Add the `robo-orchard` root command bridge, plugin loading, pydantic-settings leaf-command integration, and expanded simple-file-server behavior. (commit ed41db028b2211a4c17e9c782f2506a3efd860ab)

### Improvements

#### Configuration & Serialization

- Support Pydantic 2.13 polymorphic serialization while retaining the older supported Pydantic 2.x schema path and explicit serialization opt-out. (commit cd7105c5a1c818d0729d075453a72c57e4a067d1)
- Reject unknown configuration fields at construction and replacement boundaries while retaining private runtime bookkeeping attributes. (commit bd60704933a83f4d672788a146cf1f254ae24363)

#### Camera & Datatypes

- Expose read-only tensor `device` and `dtype` metadata on transform and joint-state datatypes and make transform inversion return its concrete batch type. (commit 365467705443880e68e27578a4ba543743bb9a6a)
- Align shared datatype `.to()` behavior with TensorDict-style copy, no-op, and explicit in-place semantics while preserving camera sensor-data dtype and graph alias safety. (commit cac543eb8bdcd5bdb849b794fdb1bf4bf1b2dabb)

#### Runtime & Utilities

- Add deterministic `OrderedTaskExecutor.close()` behavior and shared Ray remote cleanup paths for environment and policy wrappers. (commits ec86b40c10c3730b8935490df82d270938b9b426, 6fce914153b67f85050d736cac8039ca4b366f42)
- Make retries, timestamp concatenation, dictionary flattening, and string matching fail clearly or document stable ordering at their public boundaries. (commit 35dd52e8f9516abc7ca51646b7984d0eb356252b)
- Lazy-load direct known CLI commands so unrelated optional command plugins are not imported during targeted startup. (commit 6aa3eaa0fa10741cde2a2f6bf862f9fe90d04f7c)

#### Developer Tooling

- Unify source license-header policy and checks across package and SCM Python sources. (commits dd6a1599dbc2176a899b62f46f5544ec40c2cf18, fe0e5294d79bd2684b3c2ae7bdf856022cb61c83)
- Accept `scm` as a valid merge-request title type so repository checks match the documented contribution convention. (commit 95f679aeedae26f7ae301d51fa98c972442731d4)

### Bug Fixes

#### Security & Configuration

- Reject simple-file-server path traversal, replace unsafe callable-string evaluation with restricted parsing, and stabilize Ray readiness and test-environment handling. (commit 0f4b7a6be80660236d2d025f5cfccffd3132d997)

#### Camera & Visualization

- Reject inconsistent camera pose metadata during concatenation, preserve transform batch sizes, and restore documented 2x3 affine-transform support. (commit 45be40b840c248d8124d1be37e2a7c35c0789ec5)
- Return valid batched data from single-camera adapters, fix notebook display imports and click coordinates, and clean up visualization resources. (commit ec86b40c10c3730b8935490df82d270938b9b426)
- Restore first-person notebook camera display and correct automatic timer units for multi-second durations. (commit 6fce914153b67f85050d736cac8039ca4b366f42)

#### Kinematics, Managers & CLI

- Make serial-chain forward kinematics honor requested frame names, correct concatenated observation-space bounds, and restore Typer-compatible file-server help. (commit 5e324d1880b5a6d44c6d0757d0c4e751ce446846)

### Documentation

#### User Documentation

- Restore warning-clean Sphinx builds by removing stale static assets, adding actionable AutoAPI dependency handling, and correcting README references. (commit 8d25d9a615ca9b1a7f98bad69eb0e21c713a00b5)
- Add a high-level architecture guide covering layers, module ownership, runtime flows, public contracts, and extension placement. (commit 98dacf63ff6fa0c7e5684af81e9a1b93d106bd74)
- Clarify child/parent pose semantics, transform composition, TF graph chains, and camera extrinsic wording across API docs and tutorials. (commits 3e1b378afc57535b401f301f037b86e57a639b12, 9580ec18a0a0b857ef3ab98fb648861f0b77a29c)
- Expand onboarding, package navigation, remote-execution coverage, control and kinematics examples, and tools-and-extensions tutorials. (commits c043e476cb6a55f00d8d365824b91adc621b68ab, bb3e06131b82ecd068bcd0898a68bfd542ca8dea)

#### Contributor Guidance

- Establish and refine repository-local contribution, Git, Python, environment, testing, and AI-assisted workflow guidance. (commits afe2ba0217e4e4e35e97461888d73c691638bc79, 82c9a4015e7547ad198fc44e358935764fb4bc06, 584aec6a0da1a7dd39a74264532eb172ba0a101c)
- Move guidance into the `.agents` layout and align its authoring, branch, validation, and cleanup rules. (commits c7070aa716f8a7546fff810ed6db33d3729ecc3f, 3b1ab718f428d56856824c8aa3012ce3d2c1498c, 5db274f26aed9c036bd1139419615bfdab6740da)
- Settle the disposable agent-work path on `.agents/scratch` and synchronize ignore rules with the final convention. (commits 618b3f21730331523cbb21338be7b78530d72034, 7fae147ddf0ef4fdb6a3c4548899e10ff80e9ccc)
- Add spatial naming guidance and align helper-extraction and transform-comment rules. (commits c2439068c2d145433650f50e61551733effa7871, d3be43dbc60b5bb2dfc6e6b137b7365ed7553b30)
- Add public-artifact and interface-docstring guidance for published repository surfaces. (commits 5a27e4a2dddb644e525a1372adcec0f545f7ea3d, 98fcbc0d7d558ea7aea7d9063e990bf1035fbc84)
- Add architecture-review coverage for framework hooks and distill stable iterative-development, branch-safety, lazy-import, and hardware-test practices. (commits 8fcc54319d4d1e756e72a7097552e56d59b79381, d66f7b2858a2b8db6c1938f42d1f743178a919ef)
- Expand code-review, feature-development, design-document, docstring, environment-bootstrap, and experience-distillation guidance and templates. (commits ed41db028b2211a4c17e9c782f2506a3efd860ab, 6aa3eaa0fa10741cde2a2f6bf862f9fe90d04f7c)

### Compatibility

#### Versioning & Dependencies

- Advance the package version line through 0.5.0 to the selected 0.6.0 release target. (commits ae83c81b8b37ab9a99f4d0c4d994eac4f492e1ee, ed41db028b2211a4c17e9c782f2506a3efd860ab)
- Support Pydantic 2.13 with a compatible numpydantic floor, while keeping Pydantic 3 outside the supported range. (commit cd7105c5a1c818d0729d075453a72c57e4a067d1)
- Keep development requirements on NumPy 1.x for validated CI compatibility. (commit e18ba91bc16e8de4fa4a71de2ef022eb020002ad)
- Include `requests-toolbelt` in SCM build dependencies used by Twine upload flows. (commit a6e0ab724fdafc05246f2bebe012dc7e4f4bc569)

#### Behavior Boundaries

- Treat real datatype backend conversions as copy-returning by default; no-op conversions return the same object and explicit mutation requires `inplace=True`. (commit cac543eb8bdcd5bdb849b794fdb1bf4bf1b2dabb)
- Treat unknown public config fields and complex or side-effectful lambda strings as invalid input. (commits bd60704933a83f4d672788a146cf1f254ae24363, 0f4b7a6be80660236d2d025f5cfccffd3132d997)

### Migration Guide

#### Datatype Conversion

- Update callers that depended on implicit mutation from `.to()` to retain the returned object or pass `inplace=True` deliberately. (commit cac543eb8bdcd5bdb849b794fdb1bf4bf1b2dabb)

#### Configuration

- Remove unknown config keys before constructing or replacing models, and replace complex serialized lambda expressions with supported explicit callables or simple side-effect-free expressions. (commits bd60704933a83f4d672788a146cf1f254ae24363, 0f4b7a6be80660236d2d025f5cfccffd3132d997)
- Correct invalid encoded-camera shape hints or codec-option combinations that now fail at the datatype boundary instead of being ignored or inferred ambiguously. (commit a6e0ab724fdafc05246f2bebe012dc7e4f4bc569)
